videos.title: My Tinnitus Sound Experiment: Buzzing Sounds with Pulsing White Noise & Soft High-Frequency Tone
videos.description: I tried to recreate the sounds I hear every minute of every day because of my tinnitus. My tinnitus is a mixture of electrical buzzing, white noise resembling the static of an old television, a softer high-pitched ringing tone in the background, and subtle pulsations. At times, the buzzing reminds me of the electrical sounds near high-voltage power lines. I hear different sounds in each ear, with a stronger and more complex buzzing sensation in my left ear.
